adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug. Looking at lines 1060-1068, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [eventType.destinationCalendar] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [organizerUser.destinationCalendar] : null`. When neither eventType nor organizerUser has a destinationCalendar, it's set to `null`. Then at line 1078, `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` uses optional chaining, which means if `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the push operation is skipped entirely. This means team members' destination calendars collected in `teamDestinationCalendars` are discarded when neither the event type nor organizer has a destination calendar configured. The fix should initialize to an empty array `[]` instead of `null` in the fallback case.
